# synology_user_home (Resource)

Local, domain and LDAP user-home service policy. This always-present DSM service requires import before any write; begin with an import-only plan using the running DSM policy. Create refuses to discard a previous asynchronous operation through replacement. Existing home-folder relocation is rejected because it moves user data. Recycle-bin and encryption information are observed only; manage an existing homes share through its own protected share resource. Destroy releases management without disabling homes or deleting files.

## Adopt existing settings

Use an initialized project from [Check the NAS connection](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/synology/latest/docs#check-the-nas-connection). Add this import block with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_user_home.main
  id = "user_home"
}
```

1. Add the resource block with the values DSM currently reports. Use the sample configuration as a starting point.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to DSM and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_user_home" "main" {
  enabled        = false
  domain_enabled = false
  ldap_enabled   = false

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_enabled` (Boolean) Enable domain user homes. Local user homes must remain enabled. Disabling local homes requires explicitly disabling any enabled dependent home service.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable local user homes. Omission preserves the observed policy. DSM feasibility checks must pass before any change.
- `ldap_enabled` (Boolean) Enable LDAP user homes. Local user homes must remain enabled.
- `location` (String) Volume path for initial home-folder creation, such as /volume1. Omission retains the existing location. Changing an established location is refused; perform data migration separately and import the resulting configuration.

### Read-Only

- `encryption` (Number) Observed DSM home-folder encryption state. This resource never creates or rotates encryption keys.
- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: user_home.
- `operation_id` (String) Acknowledged background-task identifier while an operation is pending; empty after confirmed convergence.
- `personal_photo_enabled` (Boolean) Observed Personal Photo dependency. Local homes cannot be disabled while it remains enabled.
- `reconciliation_required` (Boolean) An unfinished or uncertain operation is retained in state. Acknowledged tasks resume through read-only polling. An unacknowledged write requires DSM inspection and explicit management release/import before retry.
- `recycle_bin_enabled` (Boolean) Observed homes-share recycle-bin policy. This resource never changes share settings.
- `remote_location` (String, Sensitive) Observed remote home location. Mutations are refused while remote homes are configured.
